Defines the floatV classifier by Float membership and exclusion of Int and Bool.

Relates the supplied intOf operation to the proof-local intLikeTotal summary over integralV; Stage 1 uses this simplification in its connection builds but never first proves the exact rule in a module that omits it.
Macro-defines willItFlyClosure as the exact translated closure syntax while leaving call and body execution to the supplied semantics.
SUM-CONNECTION.reverse-slice first proves this exact arbitrary-suffix slice-continuation transition under SUMMARY-DEFINITION, whose import closure omits VERIFICATION and therefore omits this rule.

SUM-CONNECTION.sum-fold is proved first under bridge-free SUMMARY-DEFINITION with the identical transition and the broader allIntegral guard, so its theorem specializes to this rule's allIntegral-and-no-float domain.

FLOAT-SUM-CONNECTION.float-sum-fold is proved before VERIFICATION is compiled, omits this rule, has the identical transition, and covers the broader allNumeric-and-hasFloat guard containing this rule's guarded domain.
